title: PX Audit Second Pass — Documentation Corrections, Run Inspector Enrichment, and Shell Structured UI
purpose: Resolve all findings from the PX1–PX4 independent audit: fix canonical status contradictions, enrich Run Inspector routing metadata, and replace shell placeholder JSON dumps with structured section renderers
problem: The PX1–PX4 independent audit revealed: (1) current-state.md still lists LAN Security Hard Gate as not built when PX2 implemented it, (2) dev:status ERROR about project-state active/idle consistency not caught, (3) Run Inspector missing routing/qualification reason fields, (4) shell is a navigation wrapper over raw JSON previews with 8/11 sections using placeholder renderers and no Run Inspector drill-down

included: Fix current-state.md: move LAN Security Hard Gate from 'What Is Not Built Yet' to 'What Works'
Fix current-state.md: clarify relay trust boundary line to distinguish API-level auth from node-to-node trust
Fix dev:status drift detection to cover project-state active/idle consistency
Add routing/qualification reason metadata to console run step records
Replace shell renderPlaceholder() for Runs, Workflows, Nodes, Evidence, Reviews with structured renderers
Integrate Run Inspector drill-down into shell's Runs section
Enhance shell demo result with evidence preview and export action
Unify status indicator styling between shell and console
Add keyboard navigation support to shell nav links
excluded: New product features or workflows beyond audit remediation
Reopening accepted PX2 (LAN Security Hard Gate) scope

acceptanceCriteria.description: current-state.md no longer lists LAN Security Hard Gate under 'What Is Not Built Yet'; it appears under 'What Works' with correct context
current-state.md relay trust boundary line distinguishes API-level Bearer auth (built) from node-to-node trust boundary (not built)
dev:status detects and ERRORs when project-state status is 'active' but no milestone has status 'active'
Console run step records include routing/qualification reason fields where applicable
Shell Runs section shows structured Run Inspector with drill-down to individual run details
Shell Workflows, Nodes, Evidence, and Reviews sections show structured data instead of raw JSON placeholders
Shell demo result shows evidence preview and provides export action
Shell Settings section renders meaningful UI content
Shell and console use consistent status indicator styling
npm run dev:status passes without ERROR-level contradictions introduced by this work; all existing shell and golden path tests still pass
